title: Holtburger window-global API surface
description: Curated catalog of `window.*` globals that plugins, HUD widgets, and the renderer rely on. Generated during HUD rec #184 (D18 pane-mgmt). Not enforced at runtime — surface visible for feature planning and regression review. Bump `version` and edit this file whenever a new load-bearing global is added/renamed/removed; index.html links to this schema from the post-login assignment site (search for `__sessionHandle = handle`).

lifecycle.preLogin: All __session* / __plugin* / __mainPanel / __barInstance globals are absent or null until createClient resolves post-login. __hbWasm, getLocalPlayerPose, __pluginClientReady, and the debug-capture hooks exist from module init.
lifecycle.postLogin: index.html LoginComplete handler assigns __sessionHandle, __notifyAnimationDone, __pluginClient (via createClient(handle)), and resolves __pluginClientReady. Plugins should `await window.__pluginClientReady` rather than poll.
lifecycle.disconnect: __sessionHandle, __pluginClient, and __barInstance are nulled on disconnect/reconnect. Cached references on plugin closures will silently no-op until the next login. Read-through getters (e.g. window.getLocalPlayerPose) survive the bounce.

__sessionHandle.lifecycle: null pre-login; set in index.html post-login (search `window.__sessionHandle = handle`); null'd on disconnect.
__sessionHandle.consumers: scene3d/*, plugins/* (most use it indirectly via __pluginClient).
__sessionHandle.stability: Direct access is intentional but plugins are encouraged to prefer __pluginClient facades where one exists — the wasm signature is more brittle across rebuilds than the JS layer.

__pluginClient.lifecycle: Created post-login alongside __sessionHandle; null'd on disconnect.

shape.events: EventBus — on/off/emit; see api.js coverage table (~18 Chorizite-equivalent events)

__pluginClient.stability: Public surface for third-party plugins. Add new methods; do not rename.

__pluginClientReady.lifecycle: Resolved by index.html when createClient runs.
__pluginClientReady.usage: `const client = await window.__pluginClientReady;` — replaces the legacy poll-setInterval pattern (P3-41).

__mainPanel.consumers: hotkey dispatch (~index.html:1750-1790), bar, manifest hotkey table.

methods.pushView(name): Open a panel by id and add to back-stack.
methods.showView(name): Open a panel without touching the back-stack.
methods.toggleView(name): Toggle visibility; safest entry-point for unknown state.

__hbWasm.lifecycle: Populated immediately after wasm module load. Re-bound on hot wasm rebuild.
__hbWasm.stability: Plugins MAY typeof-guard each entry; a stale pkg/ silently omits newer riders rather than throwing on module parse (F18-2 pattern).

__barInstance.lifecycle: Set when mountBar runs (pluginsDisabled gate); undefined when ?plugins=none.
__barInstance.fallback: When undefined, callers go straight to window.__sessionHandle (see ~L1797-1800 comment block).

__pluginListWire.source: index.html — set from plugins/loader.js::formatPluginList(loaded) after loadPlugins resolves.
__pluginListWire.lifecycle: "" from module init; the `id@version` roster once the loader resolves; stays "" under ?plugins=none (the loader never runs).
__pluginListWire.consumers: window.__publishPluginList only — it is the JS-side staging value for the wasm 0x02AE answer, not a plugin API.
__pluginListWire.usage: P6.1 plugin-manifest wire pair: GameEvent 0x02AE -> GameAction 0x02AF. "" means "no plugin API" and the wasm session replies with retail's "3rd party API not in use.".

__publishPluginList.source: index.html — defined next to the pluginsDisabled probe.
__publishPluginList.lifecycle: Exists from module init. Called after the loader resolves and again after every `window.__sessionHandle = handle` (a reconnect gets a fresh wasm session with an empty roster).
__publishPluginList.consumers: index.html; safe for plugins to call after a manual load/unload.
__publishPluginList.fallback: Returns false (no throw) when __sessionHandle is absent or the pkg/ predates SessionHandle.setPluginList — the wasm side then answers 0x02AE with the retail no-API string.

__notifyAnimationDone.purpose: Renderer entities.js calls back into the wasm SessionHandle to acknowledge an MT-queued AnimationDone overlay completion. Pre-v4 pkg/ soft-degrades to a no-op.
__notifyAnimationDone.stability: Internal — keep typeof-guarded on the caller side.

getLocalPlayerPose.purpose: HUD widgets (radar heading, map cursor) read the local pose without binding the wasm handle directly — survives disconnect/reconnect.
getLocalPlayerPose.stability: Stable — added in HUD rec #25 (D18 frame-seam).

__wom.source: Chorizite WorldObjectManager mirror, populated lazily after start_session.
__wom.consumers: Plugins/debugger that need the Chorizite WorldObject taxonomy.

entityMap.purpose: Capture-script visibility into the renderer entity table.
entityMap.stability: Debug-only. Do NOT depend from production plugin code.

liveScene.purpose: Capture-script visibility into the 3D scene root.
liveScene.stability: Debug-only. Do NOT depend from production plugin code.

wasmExportManifestContract.rule: Bump BOTH together when adding a load-bearing wasm export. Mismatch fires an on-screen banner and console.error (F18-2).

additionGuide: 1. Set/null the global at a single, documented site in index.html.
2. Add an entry to this schema with kind, type, source, lifecycle, consumers.
3. If wasm-backed, bump EXPECTED_WASM_MANIFEST_VERSION (JS) and WASM_EXPORT_MANIFEST_VERSION (Rust).
4. Typeof-guard consumers when the global may be absent (stale pkg/, pre-login, disconnect).
